title: Check group “{name}”
failed: The matrix could not be updated: {reason}
outdated: The matrix below is out of date: it shows the group before the last change.
keyboard: Tab moves through the cells; Enter opens a cell.

picker.title: {column} in {label}
picker.noTracks: This file has no track of this kind.
picker.defaultsAudio: This column comes from the group's audio defaults, which cannot be changed for one file. Edit the group's audio once to turn the defaults into rules that can be picked per file.
picker.defaultsSubtitle: This column comes from the group's subtitle defaults, which cannot be changed for one file. Edit the group's subtitles once to turn the defaults into rules that can be picked per file.

name.title: Name fields of {label}
name.hint: An edit applies to this file only. Clear a field to use the parsed value again.

queue.addedFailed: {n} job added to the queue; it failed | {n} jobs added to the queue; {failed} of them failed
queue.moreFailed: … and {n} more failed job: the queue lists it. | … and {n} more failed jobs: the queue lists them.
queue.queuedUncropped: Queued {n} job; its crop could not be detected | Queued {n} jobs; the crop of {uncropped} could not be detected
queue.moreUncropped: … and {n} more file is not cropped. | … and {n} more files are not cropped.
queue.stale: {n} file is queued without part of its per-file changes: they were made for an earlier version of the group (its warning in the matrix says which). | {n} files are queued without part of their per-file changes: they were made for an earlier version of the group (their warnings in the matrix say which).
queue.changed: {n} file of the group changed since it was opened | {n} files of the group changed since they were opened
queue.changedHelp: Remove it from the sources and open it again: | Remove them from the sources and open them again:

dialog.title: Some files have errors
